analogy.rationale: RIPK1 is a kinase in the TNF/NF-kB and necroptosis signaling axis, but these cell lines are not immune cells and RIPK1 inhibition alone typically produces little transcriptional change without a death stimulus. Inhibitors of the same inflammatory kinase cascade (IKK, NF-kB, JNK, p38) are the closest expected analogs, though their baseline responses are also modest.
